limitations: Fills are modelled on candle prices (bid candles; ask = bid + the candle's stored spread, else the configured spread). Real fills, requotes and broker stop levels may differ.
When a candle touches both the stop and the target, the order is unknown; the intrabar rule decides and such trades are flagged as ambiguous.
Swap / financing, partial fills and spread widening inside a candle are not modelled. Margin is checked at entry (ounces x price / leverage) like the paper simulator; margin calls are not modelled.
Decisions use only candles closed by each step cut-off; a gap in the data can delay or cancel an entry.
Small samples say little about how the rules behave; ratio metrics are withheld below the minimum trade count.

result.disclaimer: Hypothetical results computed on past data with the stated assumptions. They are not trading results, they include no live execution, and they do not predict future performance.

assumptions.signal: a change of classification into BULLISH or BEARISH (signal@1); a persisting classification counts once
assumptions.horizon: 12 M5 candles (60 minutes) after the signal cut-off
assumptions.analytical: signed close-to-close move from the signal's reference price; flat when within ±0.25 x ATR(M5); MFE/MAE from candle highs and lows
assumptions.entry: open of the first base candle after the cut-off; long at ask + slippage, short at bid - slippage
assumptions.stop: the signal's first invalidation level, else 1.5 x ATR(M5); a gap through the stop fills at the candle open
assumptions.exit: first of stop, target or the horizon close; stop assumed first when both are touched in one candle

costs.spread: each candle's stored spread; the configured spread when the dataset has none

assumptions.size: 0.1 lots x 100 troy_oz per lot (instrument XAUUSD - hypothetical demonstration specification)
assumptions.positions: one hypothetical position at a time per timeframe stream
